question: ______ is the centre for the Indian Institution of Soil Science.
solution:
The correct answer is __Bhopal__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Soil Science** is an **autonomous **institute for higher learning for **advanced research in the field of soil sciences.**
 
• It was established under the umbrella of the **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) **by the **Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India.**
 
• The **Indian Institute of Soil Science (IISS)** was established in 1988 in Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh) with an aim to **promote scientific research on soil sciences.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points:__**

The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) 

 
• The **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) **is an **autonomous organization** under the** Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.**
 
• It was established on 16 July 1929 as a registered society under the **Societies Registration Act, 1860** in pursuance of the report of the Royal Commission on Agriculture.
 
• The **ICAR** has its headquarters in New Delhi. 
 
• The Council is the apex body for co-ordinating, guiding, and managing research and education in agriculture including horticulture, fisheries, and animal sciences in the entire country.
